steps.name: Medea's Visit
steps.objective: Turn in the quest to [Glinda] in 「Dorothy Village」.

steps.name: Opening the Way
steps.objective: Talk to [Glinda] in 「Dorothy Village」, then defeat [Lepica] in 「Moksha」 to obtain <Highland White Herb>. Then turn in the quest to [Glinda] in 「Dorothy Village」.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I suspected as much...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Lady Glinda, thank you for waiting until I brought it up. To be honest, I was a little worried. You could have prevented me from coming...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I have no reason to bar someone who bears no ill will. You are not Daphne.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, what you wanted to discuss...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I should give you some privacy. Speak freely.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You are welcome to listen as well, Lady Glinda.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Am I?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Then I shall. Medea, have some tea too.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you. It has a lovely fragrance.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, if you don't mind, could you spare me some time?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there something you need my help with? Something Daphne left...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: For some time, she has continued leaving clues that only I can see and sense.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: As though asking me to find something she has hidden.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So whenever I had time, I searched Freios for the traces our ancestors left behind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you mean Creed?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes... They may have been spirits, like the ancestors of the Kali.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: They were born as living beings and gained unique powers. When evil people learned of those powers, they began exploiting them.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: In Eastland, a hero from another world turned many living beings, including the Kali clan, into magic stones and tried to destroy our world to save his own.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Vice...)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Sigh. And Lux has been doing the same in Freios... I don't even want to imagine what would have happened without you, %s.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I am always grateful to you, %s.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: So am I.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was nothing...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Let me continue. You know that the children of Creed have been sacrificed for a long time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, that...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: ...I know.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It must be because Daphne turned a blind eye.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: One way or another, I must face Daphne again. This seems the right time...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Perhaps this is the promise I made to her as a child.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A promise...?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: She told me that when the time came, I should seek out her intentions. As a child, I thought it was merely a game of hide-and-seek...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Now, both you and I must stop her in our own ways... In any case, every clue I gathered pointed to one place.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: But it is difficult for me to go alone. I need your help, %s.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Medea, do you mean Lindos?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes. Lindos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lindos? Where is that?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: A place where, according to legend, giants who followed the gods lived before the Twilight era.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: It lies north of Alfheim and is now forbidden to enter. Once, many visited it as a sacred site said to hold divine energy.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Then demons and devils suddenly appeared and people died. The Dokkalfr priests dealt with the situation and sealed the path.
(Passing by, Elliot seems to hear the conversation and stops.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It seems Daphne has hidden something there.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Of all places to hide it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It must be no ordinary place.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: A rabbit with many things to hide always enters a deep burrow.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Hmm... Wait. Did you ask %s for help because of the legend? Because they follow a god?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What legend?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: There is a tale that a group called heroes discovered a giant's weapon there.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Medea, even if you follow that legend to Lindos, the chance of finding anything is slim. But if Daphne planned this...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Your arrival here must be part of it too.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I had a vague suspicion. I knew a witch had made some kind of deal with Dorothy, but I never thought it was Daphne.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I am sorry...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Medea, you have nothing to apologize for.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, you don't know exactly what we need to find, do you?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I think we will only know once we get there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then when shall we leave?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, you really cannot sit still.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As I said before, I feel better when I'm doing something.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. Don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: But what shall we do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: As I just said, there is currently no path to Lindos anywhere in Freios.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So sealing the path meant making it impossible for anyone to find...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Therefore, we must force a path open.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You know a way, Lady Glinda. If something must be made, I will gather the ingredients.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Will you be all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, we'll be fine.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Once you bring all the ingredients, I will try to open a path to Lindos. Take your time.

steps.name: A Brief Rest
steps.objective: Talk to [Glinda] in 「Dorothy Village」, then go to [Runo]. Then turn in the quest to [Mandarava] on 「Oscar Road」.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We have brought the ingredients as you instructed, Lady Glinda.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Highland White Herbs... This should be enough. Well done, both of you.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Originally, I needed an ingredient from Emeraldia, but fortunately there is a substitute. It should work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Emeraldia...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Now all that remains is to combine them.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Why not wait and recover your strength in the meantime?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Understood. Is that all right with you too, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, we'll be fine.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Good. I'll make sure you rest properly until then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That sounds a little frightening...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Hahaha! Don't worry. I won't kill you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then we are in your care, Lady Glinda.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: %s, the boss will be here shortly. Wait a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Runo.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you for your hospitality during my stay. I was very comfortable.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: I'm glad to hear that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Binah, Leticia. I told you there was no need to see us off.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Oh, come on. We'd regret it later if we didn't. Meow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: What for?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We came to Dorothy Village together, but now it feels like I'm leaving you behind.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: It's fine. You're only going away for a little while. I'll be training hard while you're gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Training?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yep. I'll have to work even harder when we return. For training, Binah and I are going to organize the Munchkin Warehouse.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. Leave me out of it. Organizing the warehouse is hard.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I've already told Glinda that Binah and I will tidy it properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... Letty, I'll return as soon as I can. We have to go back to Glaston together.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: That's right. We do.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Take care too, big sister Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Aren't you older? Then am I the big sister?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I am probably the older one. Thank you.
(Medea gives Leticia a small smile.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I kept you waiting. I'd already made the arrangements, but I went to the warehouse to check.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The warehouse?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Mandarava needs to be outside the village. I placed a crystal with properties similar to an Imperial Gate inside him.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I combined something I saved when a gate connecting Alfheim's villages and regions broke with the ingredients you brought.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what does Mandarava need to do?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Mandarava does nothing. You do it. Pick him up in both hands and throw him north with all your strength.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: With all your strength.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, that sounds fun.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: A path north will open where Mandarava lands.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Yes. Then wait until Mandarava comes back.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Mom... Does Mandarava know about this?

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: The boss recently obtained the finest stuffing. Mandarava seems to be eagerly anticipating it.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So this method works because the spirit likes stuffing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Everyone seems to accept this awfully easily...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then we'll go meet Mandarava on the road. We'll be back, Glinda.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you for everything, Lady Glinda.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I hardly did anything. Return safely. That's all I ask.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: I hope you encounter no trouble.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Take care!

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. Goodbye.
(The villagers turn back after seeing Medea and the adventurer off. Then Binah stops, apparently remembering something, and catches Leticia's arm.)

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. Letty.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: I haven't seen Elliot. Have you?

steps.name: Help from a Great Spirit
steps.objective: Talk to [Mandarava] on 「Oscar Road」, then turn in the quest to [Medea] in 「Lindos Holy Land」.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I'm the perfect herb spirit, unstoppable by anyone! Lying in the warmth and basking in the sun. ♬
(Mandarava reclines against a rock and sings a strange song.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There you are, spirit.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Whoa! You startled me!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you finished gathering herbs and started playing?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: You make it sound as though I'm a spirit who plays instead of working.
(Mandarava shakes his body, and a mandrake pokes its face out through the zipper.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I even caught a runaway herb! Hehe!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Didn't the mandrake run away because you gave it advice as a senior herb again?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I said I was its teacher, not its senior.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I meant no harm. Medea, say something.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Perhaps because it heard your words, the mandrake looks quite happy.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Really? Medea understands my profound intentions. Ahem.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: You don't seem to have come to the road to gather herbs. Are you leaving?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, we are.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: The road to Alfheim isn't here. How will you go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glinda said a path would open on the Oscar Road if we followed her instructions.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: A path will open if you do as Glinda says? All right. Travel safely, then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Mandarava, you don't know the method?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It seems the spirit has not been told.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glinda recently bought some top-quality stuffing...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Oooooh! I knew that stuffing was mine!!

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Lady Glinda said we should mention the new stuffing when we spoke to you.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: So you need the help of the magnificent herb spirit Mandarava! What should I do? Hurry, tell me!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry, Mandarava.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Sorry for what? Huh? Why are you grabbing me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You'll find out soon.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Huh? Whoa! Oh! Waaaaah!!
(Before Mandarava can say anything, he is thrown toward the northern end of the road.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The spirit... is flying like a star in the sky.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't think he'd fly that far...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm glad your strength has recovered enough to throw him so far.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for worrying. They say I slept for a whole week, but I don't really remember.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You seem fine outwardly, but if you feel strange or unwell in any way, please tell me immediately.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, something is sparkling in the direction the spirit flew... Can you see it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you're right! It's sparkling over there.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It seems the path has formed.
(Just then, Mandarava rides the wind back to the adventurer and Medea.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: %s, you're terrible! You threw this magnificent herb spirit and made me tumble at the road's boundary!

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Did you have to make the path to Lindos like that?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was Glinda's method.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Of course, Glinda. An excellent method.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you for understanding, spirit.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Medea, as long as I get new stuffing, I'm fine. New stuffing...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Then allow me to kindly explain!

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Go straight that way to reach Lindos in Alfheim. But it's dangerous there. Will you two be all right?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We will.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: It's already a strange place full of strange beings. If Daphne visited, it'll be even more complicated.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We'll have to go and see.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: This magnificent spirit will wait here for your return.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then we'll be off.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Until next time, spirit.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Bye-bye.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: They've all gone. Elliot seemed to be going somewhere too... To a beast's nest, perhaps?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Ah, who knows. All I need is sunlight. Ah, so waaarm...

steps.name: Steps toward the Holy Land
steps.objective: Talk to [Medea] in 「Lindos Holy Land」, then defeat [Crucuru] and [Annoying Decarabia]. Then turn in the quest to [Hilda] in 「Lindos Holy Land」.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, from here we enter the sacred land of Lindos.
(Medea pushes aside enormous flowers with her staff, revealing a path that squeezes between rocky hills.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've traveled all over Freios, but I've never seen a place like this.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Perhaps because giants once lived here? Everything is enormous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It certainly seems forbidden. There are even signs telling us not to enter...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea?
(Medea raises her head and gazes at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Lindos is filled with an ominous feeling. It seems someone here does not welcome us.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And there is more than one. I think a witch is here too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A witch? Daphne?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: No, definitely not Daphne. She would not leave traces of her presence like this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: ...I cannot be certain who it is.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A witch Medea knows besides Daphne...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh... What's wrong with me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I felt a little dizzy.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: For now, yes...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If you're unwell, perhaps we should rest...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Medea. Let's go.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Very well. But please don't push yourself too hard.

steps.name: Different Paths, the Same Goal
steps.objective:
1. Follow [Hilda], who has disappeared somewhere in 「Lindos Holy Land」.
2. Once you find [Hilda] and the scene is over, defeat [Optimistic Tyren], then return to [Hilda]'s original location and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Ugh...
(Hilda sinks to the ground, clutching her head.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I thought I could hide here without anyone bothering me...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Damn... Is that one coming...?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I can't stay here... I have to go...
(As though sensing something, Hilda raises her head and looks ahead.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Daphne...? No...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: ...I have to hide... I can't stay here. If I stay... Ugh...
(Hilda struggles to her feet, looks around, and swiftly leaves before anyone can find her.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Where did she go? She was definitely here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think she sensed me coming and hid somewhere.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, are you all right now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm better thanks to you. It's hard to explain, but it doesn't feel like simple healing.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I merely stabilized your soul. It is a kind of... ability I possess...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't tell me...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I did not understand as a child. That my ability had manifested this way because Daphne wanted it to...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Perhaps I can help Hilda too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then we might be able to have a proper conversation with her. I need to know why she's here.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So you wanted to speak with Hilda.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whenever I follow traces connected to witches, Hilda is there. And something she said to Iris troubles me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That what Kazno and Jeril are trying to do could bring unexpected consequences for everyone...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then we must find Hilda first. Hearing it directly is the surest way.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Hah, hah...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It hurts...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Why am I the only one who has to suffer like this? Why must I be the one to run...?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Why only me...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: No... I don't want to meet my end like this...
(At that moment, Hilda sees %s pursuing her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda. Wait!

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Stay right there. Don't come closer!!
(Her emotions erupt uncontrollably, sharpening her gaze. At the same time, the surrounding space begins to distort.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, I'm dizzy... Stop, Hilda.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: What's wrong with you? This never happened to you before. Why are you... Ugh...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Both of you, step back!!
Thud.
(Medea, following behind, drives her staff into the ground. The tremors stop instantly, and the two facing each other collapse.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Is everyone all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm all right for now... But Hilda...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Hah, hah...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, step back for a moment. I'll speak with Hilda.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...
(As the adventurer takes a step back, Medea quietly approaches Hilda.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So you know me.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Among those who bear the black moon's fate, no one doesn't know you. Someone we cannot carelessly touch... Ugh...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, come to me.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If you will not come, I will come to you.
(Medea approaches the hesitant Hilda.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Lower your head for a moment.
(Medea lifts her staff and taps Hilda's shoulder. A small light blooms at its tip and envelops her.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This should keep you well for a while.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: How did you do that?
(Hilda looks up at Medea in confusion.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Why show me such kindness? You could try to kill me like the other witches...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I could, if I chose to. But I did not. There is no need.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And I know you would not die willingly.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You have stayed in Lady Glinda's village, so you know not every witch needs to be an enemy.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: True. But I don't understand why you came with that one. Medea, you know, don't you? About our souls...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: That's why I can't trust this.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I had some idea. But that changes nothing.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, you seem to have a reason for coming to Lindos... As things stand, you will remain in this condition while we are here.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s had similar symptoms, so I helped them recover too.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It isn't something that gets better through simple healing.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I know. But we cannot leave you suffering.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Don't tell me, Medea...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, come here. Hilda is all right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while since we've met like this.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: ...It seems Medea was right. I feel better.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, were you looking for something Daphne hid?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Not something Daphne hid, but she told me to come here if I wanted to find what I needed.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Our goals differ, but we may be taking the same path...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, with Medea here, we'll both be all right.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'll go separately.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, as long as what you seek is in Lindos, leaving like this will make things difficult for everyone.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And there is something only %s can do.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: That sounds like you're saying coming to Lindos is pointless without that one...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: So I'm right. Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, wait...
(As though by agreement, everyone looks in the same direction.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The monsters' movements have changed.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Follow me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You said you had something to find.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Let's go, %s. We can check there.

steps.name: A Being Consumed by the Abyss
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Hilda] in 「Lindos Holy Land」, then enter 「Helepol Fortress」.
2. Defeat [Dmitri] in 「Helepol Fortress」 and obtain <Wrath Turned to Ash>. Then turn in the quest to [Hilda] in 「Lindos Holy Land」.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: What a welcome they're giving us.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Why are you looking at me like that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing. I just think there's something big over there.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: So there really is something inside Helepol Fortress.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Helepol Fortress?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, look east from here. Do you see all those statues?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, those statues... Could they depict ancient gods? There's a goddess statue that feels similar to Seres.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: That's Helepol Fortress. A giant who followed the gods built it before the Twilight era.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The giant who made the weapon?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes. The giant was skillful with his hands and could make anything well.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It was originally a temple-like place honoring the gods' achievements. Over time, those with nowhere to go began staying there.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: They say that during the Twilight era, several ancient gods descended here to escape something.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Many gods stayed, perhaps believing the giant's creation was safe. Afterward, it became a place that saved many lives...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Now it is crawling with monsters, including devils and demons...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never knew it had such a history... But Medea, how do you know about the giant?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: When I was a child... She told me.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Another witch with a cruel fate.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We will.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You wouldn't have come all the way from Kali if you weren't all right.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You know Kali Village?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I traveled with Daphne briefly. She told me there had been a beloved child she cherished deeply in that village.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Daphne rarely shows her feelings, but she was very happy whenever she talked about Medea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When did you travel with Daphne?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: From before your decisive battle at Avalon. To avoid Ouroboros, I had no choice but to stay with someone as powerful as Daphne.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ouroboros...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Let's deal with what brought us here first. Don't worry. I won't disappear on you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Aren't we going in? Whatever's inside seems far from ordinary... Are you not ready?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The evil energy reaches all the way here. It is overpowering.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth is inside Helepol Fortress...? Oh, Medea?
(Medea taps Hilda's and %s's shoulders with her staff.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: As long as we stay together and do not overexert ourselves, we should be all right.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I don't know how long this will take, but I'm counting on you. I'll lead here. Follow me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.
(Climbing the stairs between two goddess statues reveals a gorge deeper than the sacred land of Lindos.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Those are all statues, right? They're set along every cliff. Is that colossal statue looking inward?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: To think the giant made all this alone...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It looks sacred, but I sense evil energy everywhere.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There seems to be a poisonous miasma.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, there's poison here?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You can't feel it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I wondered if you were just dull, but Medea's restorative power really is exceptional.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm dull?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Don't concern yourself with such trivial things.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Both of you, look ahead.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Something black is flying toward us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Let's find out.
(At Hilda's words, Medea adjusts her grip on her staff. Hilda draws a small dagger and readies herself.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s, don't do anything yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: There's something I need to check. When I signal later, attack.
(With those words, the black object flies in and stops before the group.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A devil...? No, a devil statue.
(The devil-shaped figure stares at the group, radiating ominous energy.)
「Hehehe.」
(A grotesque laugh comes from the gaps in the statue's skull-like face.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It does not seem to be a guardian gargoyle...
「How dare you compare me to a mere gargoyle. Fools. Turn back.」

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: We'll leave when we're finished.
「I, Dmitri, do not permit your entry into Helepol.」
(The statue calling itself Dmitri raises its sword toward the group.)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「If you will not leave, I shall cut you all down here.」

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: How predictable. You never intended to let us live anyway, did you, Dmitri?

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「How dare a mere mortal speak the name of a great being so lightly.」

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Going on about mortals makes your identity rather obvious. Don't worry. I've spoken the name of someone greater than you and survived.

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「And who might that be?」

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: The goddess of the black moon.
(At Hilda's answer, Dmitri swings his sword.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh...
(%s's group avoids Dmitri's attack, but the powerful impact drives them far back.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Do you have a grudge against Hecate?

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Hehehe...」

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「So you are that woman's creations. I shall kill every last one of you.」

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, could that statue be...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'm not certain, but it seems a Twisted One is trapped in the statue. From its behavior, you'd think it was a devil...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Everyone, watch out!!
(A blade-like wind rises from Dmitri's sword and attacks the group.)
(Hilda and Medea try to counterattack, but strangely, their attacks rebound as though blocked by something.)
(They try several times, yet neither can land a blow.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: ...Hilda.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: The goddess of the black moon is no help at all. But it's all right.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Hehehe... Hecate's brood. Do you think the black moon's energy can touch the great Dmitri? You may buy yourselves time, but...」
Thud.
(Something falls beneath Dmitri with a loud crash.)
(Clutching one shoulder, Dmitri looks down at the devil statue's arm lying on the ground.)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Another nuisance. I am curious about your name, but I will not ask. What use is knowing the names of those who will die...?」

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「They said no god, nor any god's creation, could touch me. Sigh.」
(With Dmitri's irritated sigh, the destroyed left arm regenerates.)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「I intended to entertain you briefly and show mercy, but that will no longer do.」

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Do not expect to leave Helepol Fortress alive.」
(Dmitri slowly beats his wings and rises into the sky.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Running away?

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「How could a foolish mortal understand a great being's will?」

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「I shall wait there. No place could be better suited to tormenting your souls.」
(The surroundings darken at those words. The darkness soon fades, but the devil statue is gone.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: He is luring us.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Medea, may I use one leaf from your staff?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Of course. But what will you use it for...?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I have a feeling we'll need it...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is she planning to use it for...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Hilda. How did you know my attack would work on Dmitri?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: We were told there was something only you could do. I simply thought that might be it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...So I literally have to use my strength. Sigh...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Simple. I like that.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We don't know what awaits where Dmitri is... But we must go and see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm ready.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: He calls himself a great being, but apparently he can't manage alone. The devils and demons that were hiding are coming.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, take the front.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: All right. And Medea...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Understood. Let us go.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Nothing personal. Your only mistake was attacking me.
(The devil fallen at Hilda's feet vanishes with a final scream.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: ...All the monsters pursuing us have withdrawn.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Now we just need to find Dmitri... %s, don't relax yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know, Hilda. But...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why don't your attacks and Medea's work on Dmitri?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I have a theory. He seems to have made some kind of promise or contract.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That must be it.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: But I doubt Hecate promised never to harm Dmitri in any way.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: As Elysia's mistress, Hecate almost never attacks other gods there. If she did, it would have been to protect the place she treasures.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: We were affected simply because of our connection to Hecate. Otherwise...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Could it be the statue trapping Dmitri? Something no god's or other being's power can affect...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Considering the giant, that seems entirely possible.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then my attacks shouldn't work either.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Yes, Iris.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: No human besides Iris has ever become a god. I don't know whether to call that an unforeseen factor, but...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Both of you. Look ahead.
(The moment the group turns forward, dark shadows fill the entire surrounding space.)
(Through them appears the devil statue, spewing wicked flames.)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「You have done well to come this far, children of Hecate.」

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Ugh, what a vile miasma...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cough, cough. So this is the poison you mentioned. It's overwhelming...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The miasma is denser than that of a high-ranking devil born in the abyss.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Don't tell me...

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「As promised, I shall kill you here. I look forward to Hecate's face as she watches you die.」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know what happened between you and Hecate, but it has nothing to do with us. Let us find what we need and leave.

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Perhaps not to you, but it does to me. You cannot know what it feels like to be trapped in a devil statue because of Hecate, and become a devil yourself!」

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I don't think Hecate has that sort of hobby... Anyway, it's a purely personal grudge.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: So will killing us be enough?

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「I shall kill you, go outside, and burn Freios as I did during the Twilight era...」
(At those words, Hilda grabs Medea's and %s's hands and hurriedly retreats.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-What?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: That is no longer a Twisted One. It is only a devil that plunged into the abyss of its own will.

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Hehehe. Quite clever. I thought you would be weak and foolish like Hecate... Graaah!」
(Wicked flames erupt around Dmitri and envelop him.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The reason our attacks did not work...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: The statue itself was made that way. So no being could destroy it, except a particular person...

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Humans calling themselves heroes once came seeking the giant's legacy...」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened to them?

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Half died and offered me their souls. Half fled. Come to think of it, you resemble the human called a hero back then. Hehehe.」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A hero...)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Offer all your souls to me!! Die here, all of you, so I may kill Hecate!!」
(At that moment, Dmitri charges the group. Far above, a boy looks down and gives a faint laugh.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: This seems a little different from what I know...

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Well, it doesn't matter. Whoever wins is on our side. Do your best.
(%s's repeated attacks break Dmitri's tail and wings, sending them to the ground, but they regenerate.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hah, hah. There's no end to it.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s. It's ready now!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda? What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Medea, handle the remaining monsters. It'll only take a moment.
(Hilda plucks a leaf from Medea's staff and walks toward Dmitri.)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Hehehe. The more I fight you, the more clearly I sense the soul within. If I could only devour a soul blessed by a god...」

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: A former god becoming a devil and coveting living souls. How pathetic.

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Hehehe. How amusing to hear such words from someone who can do nothing.」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, what are you planning?
(Hilda grins and lightly cuts the tip of her index finger with her dagger. She lets the blood drip onto the leaf from Medea.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: This!
(With those words, Hilda scatters the blood gathered on the leaf over Dmitri.)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Hehehe. If that is your declaration that you offer yourself as a sacrifice, I will accept even this insult.」

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: A shame you take it as an insult. I never thought I'd use this ability, which even gods feared, like this.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s, go and destroy as much as you like.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Hurry!
(Seizing an opening in %s's guard, Dmitri swings his sword. You barely avoid it, but the force drives you back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Hehehe. Do you weaklings truly believe you can surpass me? You shall offer your souls to me here.」

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I don't know whether we can surpass you... But I can create what wasn't there, and make what disappeared return.
(No sooner has Hilda spoken than the adventurer moves behind Dmitri and destroys his wings.)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「...Buying time with empty words. I need only regenerate.」
(Dmitri feels around where his wings should be, then screams in pain loudly enough to shake all of Helepol Fortress.)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「GAAAAAAAAAGH!!!!!!!!!」

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: The parts that should regenerate are blocked and turning inward. They'll wrap around you, trapped inside the statue.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Eventually, you'll become one with the statue, unable to come out ever again...

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Graaagh... A mere human c-could never do this. Even under Hecate's influence...」

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I am a witch. By wounding myself, I can make you unable to rise again. Unable to regenerate.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Perhaps that's why Ouroboros wants me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s, what are you doing? Finish him...
(At that moment, Dmitri grabs Hilda's wrist.)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Graaagh! Do you think I will fall like this?!」

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Let go!!

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「I shall seize you and plunge into the abyssal swamp!! I shall... Gaaaaagh!!」
(Though writhing as his whole body cracks apart, Dmitri creates a dark shadow to one side.)
(But only for a moment. The arm creating the shadow falls to the ground and crumbles to dust.)
(The devil statue struggles again to seize the adventurer, but collapses under the incoming attack.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Dmitri, you must have known your end from the moment you chose to become a devil.

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Are you mocking me...?」

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: One who is not merely twisted, but foolish...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Hilda, it seems he'll destroy himself if we leave him...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: What we seek will appear only when he vanishes.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, who are you talking to? Oh...
(A boy with bandages around his head and leg approaches, holding a cup in one hand.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Hello, everyone. I have no intention of fighting, so don't be wary.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Menoiti...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Why is a Twisted One here?

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Meno... Why are you here...? I thought you vanished back then...」

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Dmitri, be quiet. I'm speaking.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: %s, I'll help you reach the next area.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Is that all?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Yes. That's all. In return, leave Dmitri's disposal to me. I'm better suited than humans to deal with someone who was once a god.

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「How dare you creatures...」

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Perhaps, but how can we trust you?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: What would make you trust me? Oh, right. Would you trust me if I told you about the witch Daphne?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Daphne is quite remarkable. I don't know how she even altered Dmitri's memories to get inside. Even I couldn't do that. Hehe. Now...

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: %s, thank you for playing along with my little prank last time. This is my repayment.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: What you're looking for is there. Daphne hid it away very carefully.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You were watching everything?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Trade secret.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, Medea. What should we do?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: ...It seems your attack just now caused something to appear somewhere in the sacred land of Lindos, %s.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: West of where we met, right?
(Menoiti smiles at %s, who is watching him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I suppose we have to trust him and go...

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then let us head down quickly.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Goodbye. Take care.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Dmitri.

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Meno, what will you do to me...?」

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Dispose of you, exactly as I said. Unlike you, I've been given a 'chance.' So I'll live anew in the present time.
(Menoiti shakes his chalice, and it fills with water.)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「M-Meno. S-Stop. No, you mustn't...」

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Dmitri, congratulations on becoming a devil. Since we're no longer the same kind, I don't feel guilty anymore. Isn't that fortunate?
(The water in the chalice begins to boil. Soon, Menoiti pours it over the broken Dmitri's head.)

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Gaaaaagh!!」

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: If only you hadn't suggested fleeing first... If only you'd kept our promise to help Hecate...

lines.speaker: 드미트리
lines.text: 「Ghhh... Ghh...」
(Dmitri's voice is heard no more.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: This world would be many times more beautiful now...

steps.name: The One Who Calls the Giant
steps.objective:
1. Go to the place where [Hilda] was hiding in 「Lindos Holy Land」.
2. Meet the new person there, then return to [Hilda] and turn in the quest.

lines.text: (After leaving Helepol Fortress, Hilda stops and looks back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Let's rest for a moment.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Has losing blood made you unwell?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Don't worry. Look, I'm fine.
(Hilda shows the fingertip she cut with her dagger.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looks all right.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Every time I wasn't all right before, it was because of you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why say it like that...?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Don't worry about such trivial things.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Wait, both of you... Would you look behind us?
(At Medea's words, the adventurer and Hilda look toward Helepol Fortress's entrance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Look where the colossal statue you admired is facing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Oh... You're right. It's facing west.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Did that short Twisted One keep his promise? Dmitri's presence inside Helepol Fortress is gone.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The monsters following Dmitri's orders are no longer pursuing us either.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Medea, could you make this into a solid form... Say, a sphere?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Powder?
(Hilda quietly hands Medea something gathered on a leaf.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This fell from Dmitri.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I thought it might be useful, so I kept a little.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, what will you use it for?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I can't tell you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, this will take time. Something from a being who became a devil must first be purified...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: That's fine.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: How would you like to receive it when it's done? I thought I might leave it with Lady Glinda.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'll collect it from Dorothy Village. Oh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, what?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'd like you not to be in Dorothy Village when I do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You two get along better than I expected.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: ...We don't get along badly. The circumstances are bad. Oh, Medea... Look.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: ...Oh, that is...
(Something races through the wind from the west, where the group is looking.)
Briareus!!
(It nearly collides with the group, but fortunately passes everyone and continues onward.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-What was that strange thing...? It looked like a horse...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: ...It appears to be a beastfolk.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Briareus? That's the giant's name...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The giant who made the weapons and statues here?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I heard it once. I don't quite remember from whom...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda? Where are you going?!

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, let's follow for now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Medea.
Briareus...
Sigh. I know Briareus is gone, yet I...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You must have been close, calling his name like that.
Of course. Briareus was...
But who are you?
(At Hilda's appearance, a female beastfolk with a horse's legs steps back. Sensing others, she raises her sword warily.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, there you are. Oh...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That person...
A hero? Oh, Daphne? No, someone who looks similar.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know Daphne?
(The female beastfolk lowers her sword and stares at %s's group.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: If you know Daphne, this should be easier to explain.
Daphne told you to look for something here, didn't she?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That is correct.
What did you do about the devil statue in Helepol? You can't deal with it by ordinary means.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: ...We defeated it, but a Twisted One came and should have finished it off.
You defeated it? A Twisted One came?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, we need to explain this clearly.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Then you explain, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, may I explain to her?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't mind.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes...
Then tell me why you came and what happened here in a way I can understand.
Before that, I should tell you who I am.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I am Tyrenia, descendant of the Chiron clan.
(The woman introducing herself as Tyrenia pricks up her ears.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: My name is... Medea.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'm Hilda. That's %s.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then let me explain. We...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: (Medea gives Tyrenia a clear account of why the group came to Lindos.)

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I understand roughly why you're here and what happened to Lindos. I wondered when I would repay my debt to Daphne...

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: It seems today is the day.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you'll help us?

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I suppose so?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: From your reaction, Tyrenia, I think there is something more...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: If it's Daphne, she must have arranged things so Tyrenia would do something.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I'll say you're half right. Then I suppose I should tell my story...

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I heard from Daphne that they called that time the 'Twilight.' I was probably someone who lived then.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I'm not certain, but it was around then.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Someone who had been a god fell into corruption and became no different from a devil. He descended on my village to take the souls of the living.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I don't remember clearly what happened, but a spirit saved me... And brought me here to Lindos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of spirit?

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: One with an odd way of speaking. It said this place would be safe and quickly disappeared. Then...

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: The devil who had ruined our village followed me. Back then, he was a godlike being, but had become a fallen devil...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Dmitri...

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Yes. Just as Dmitri tried to take my soul, an enormous person appeared, seized him, and lured him away.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Then he appeared before me where I was hiding and offered his hand. He said he'd caught the devil and made sure it could never get out again...

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: That was my first meeting with Briareus. We became friends, and he helped me a great deal.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I learned later that the Demon Realm was collecting the souls of people like me.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Anyway, Briareus reassured me. He said demons and devils couldn't easily come because he was a giant.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: And he gave me a safe place to stay. That place is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-What?!
(As Tyrenia continues, the sacred land of Lindos suddenly shakes.)

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: ...It's nothing. Only because I, the place's guardian, have been outside too long...

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Follow me. I'll explain the rest on the way.
(No sooner has she spoken than Tyrenia races away from the group.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: She could at least slow down so we can follow...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: She cannot have gone far.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think what we're looking for is in the place Tyrenia said she guards.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: How much of this has Daphne arranged...?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, let's return to where we were just now.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: If it's a safe place made by the giant... Hmm. We'll have to see...

steps.name: Each One's Promise
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Hilda] in 「Lindos Holy Land」, then enter 「Trial of Iron」.
2. Defeat [Tyrenia] in 「Trial of Iron」 and obtain a <Black Moon Fragment>. Then turn in the quest to [Hilda] in 「Lindos Holy Land」.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: There you are.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I've been waiting. Why are you so slow?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: ...Our bodies are different. You cannot simply say that...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, Medea's angry.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Medea, are you angry?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You seem angry...

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Sorry. I ran too fast without thinking.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Now I'll take you to the place I guard. The 'Trial of Iron'...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: The Trial of Iron...

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: The place where Briareus made weapons. The metal remnants that never became perfect weapons in his hands remain there.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Think of it as both the cradle and grave of weapons.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Thanks to Briareus, I could live safely in Lindos. Ill-intentioned people came almost daily seeking his weapons, but he protected me.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Then passages to Pandemonium, a city in the Demon Realm, appeared all over the continent.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I think they were called Pseudaria...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Pseudaria...

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: You know it?

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Let's discuss the rest inside.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: As guardian of the Trial of Iron, I permit you to enter. It's this way.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: See the enormous sword among the clouds?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, there was nothing there a moment ago...

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: This path appears only after the devil statue is neutralized. It's a kind of mechanism, but complicated to explain. Briareus designed it that way from the start.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Now that Dmitri is gone, the path will never be permanently closed.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: So when the path was closed, you couldn't come outside.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I had no particular reason to go outside.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Walk without thinking too much, and you'll see something new. Follow me. I'll match your pace this time.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Trial of Iron...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It feels as though something remains...)

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Here we are.
(Following Tyrenia through the clouds, you see the scenery change.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weapons are embedded in the cliffs and rocks...

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Things that cannot, or must not, be used.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: So the giant Briareus made all of them. Different sizes, different types, and different energies...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It somehow reminds me of the Sanctuary.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: The Sanctuary?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A place where battle angels and Valkyries live.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I thought they'd all vanished. So they've been well. Michaela, Raphaella, and Gabriella...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Michaela is in the Sanctuary, and Raphaella is in the Aegir Ruins...

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: And Gabriella?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I haven't met her yet.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I see. I'd like to visit them sometime... Several of them once came here to have weapons made.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Briareus put tremendous effort into making their weapons. They sparred with me to test them too.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You said it had been a long time since you went outside... Were you unable to leave before?

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Briareus disappeared some time after the era called the Twilight.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I mentioned the Demon Realm's gates appearing across the continent, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Then someone came. Everyone called him a hero.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: The hero said he needed Briareus's weapon to close those gates. Briareus agreed to give him one if he passed several tests.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: One condition was to spar with me. I remember how pleased he was when he received a fine weapon.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: But not long after the hero left, an enormous number of demons attacked Lindos.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: The moment Briareus saw them, he put everything outside into this place. Even me...

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I thought we would see each other again then.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: But the door did not open for a very long time... Of course, I couldn't leave or see Briareus.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Eventually, the door opened. But it wasn't Briareus before me. It was a demon who had forced it open to seize the weapons.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: There was something that demon didn't know. You can only get what you want by following this place's rules, and it failed to do so.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Rules? Set by Briareus?

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Yes. The rule is to defeat Briareus in single combat. But when there's no Priring, a Puriring will do. The guardian now is me, not the giant.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: So I fought it.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then you mean we must follow that rule too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That must literally be the trial...

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Well? Will you try?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: How troublesome.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I knew it would not be easy. But which of us will face you, Tyrenia?

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: %s. I'd like it to be you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I want to test myself against someone blessed by a god. You fought Dmitri, didn't you? I'm curious. And Daphne recommended you too...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: What did Daphne do to help you, Tyrenia...?

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I'll tell you once you reach the place where I'll be waiting. I promise.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You look as though you want a proper fight... If that's the only way to get what we need, we have no choice. Sigh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then we will see you shortly, Tyrenia.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I'll go ahead and wait.
(With those words, Tyrenia races deeper into the Trial of Iron.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Somehow, it reminds me of that place in Elysia.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: That place was born from Hecate's whims. This one is a little different, though.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, %s... Look ahead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We haven't even started, and they're already coming.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s. Ready?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm ready. Shall we go?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, Hilda. Do not let your guard down. Be careful!

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: What a bother. Sigh...
(Hilda sighs quietly at the monsters fallen on the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are all these here to guard the giant's weapons...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even so, what are those beastfolk who look like Tyrenia...?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I thought you knew...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: They are spirits who accompany Tyrenia. The spirits who made weapons with the giant must have gradually taken after her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then Tyrenia is...?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Simply a person, like you, me, or Medea.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: To train in a place filled with special power and spar with battle angels, she must have worked incredibly hard.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: ...This space...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Medea, what is it?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I have the impression that Briareus had abilities beyond making weapons and statues.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Considering how he controlled this space to keep Tyrenia safe, well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, look over there.
(At the cliff's edge where Medea points, Tyrenia stands gazing at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: There she is. Huh?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, move!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right!
Crash!
(With a tremendous noise, a shield embeds itself in the ground and spins. Tyrenia descends from the cliff and charges.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh!
(As the adventurer tries to counterattack, a powerful impact drives you far back.)

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Hilda and Medea, step aside. From now on, if anyone interferes, you will gain nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Attacking without warning is a little unfair...

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: You're prepared, aren't you?
(Tyrenia picks up her fallen shield and points her sword at the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wouldn't have come this far without being prepared.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Then show me what you can do.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Show me whether you can take it from me!

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Ugh.
(Tyrenia is driven back by %s's powerful attack. She tries to counter, but her legs give way and she sinks to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Impossible...

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Sigh... It can't be helped. I lost. I acknowledge my defeat...
(Still seated, Tyrenia sighs, takes something from her clothes, and gives it to %s.)

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Daphne entrusted this to me. As promised, I'll give it to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Don't tell me...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: This is Hecate's...
(A black crescent-shaped stone glows purple in %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: From your surprise, it seems this is no ordinary object.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It symbolizes the ancient god Hecate.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I don't know what kind of god Hecate is, but I should tell you how Daphne gave me this.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: The Demon Realm passages called Pseudaria stopped appearing for a time, then returned recently.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: At that moment, this space shook, and demons and devils poured out.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I couldn't stop them all alone. Just when I thought I would die, Daphne appeared.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: With a gesture, she made the enemies fight each other. With a tap of her staff, she immobilized them. It was incredible.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: When it was over, she took my hand, helped me up, and told me to endure like Briareus. She said she would do the same...

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Then she entrusted this to me and told me to give it to Medea and Hilda when they came here someday.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: She said it was the same object, but would mean different things to each of us...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Medea, Hilda. Here...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Thank you.
(The moment Medea and Hilda take the black moon fragments in their hands, they sink to the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea! Hilda!!
(Startled, the adventurer hurriedly catches Medea and Hilda.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It is nothing. I felt dizzy for a moment...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It's all right... Nothing happened... I'm really fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: That's right...
(Medea and Hilda stare at the black moon fragments in their hands, unable to speak.)

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: You both seem to have realized something...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'm sorry, Tyrenia. We can't tell you.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I have a suspicion, but I won't ask. Knowing would surely make me sad.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Thank you for understanding.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Are you going back now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are things we need to do to prepare for danger. We'll return and get ready.
(At %s's words, Tyrenia smiles, approaches, and gently touches her forehead to yours.)

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I wish you success. This is our clan's greeting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Tyrenia.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you, Tyrenia. But what will you do now?

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Me? I'll keep guarding Briareus's legacy. That's why I'm here.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I fall short of Briareus, but if you need my help, come find me.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Becoming a blacksmith?

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Something like that. Oh, next time you come, we won't fight except for sparring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So there will still be sparring.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Sigh. It feels such a shame to let you go like this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tyrenia, don't tell me you want to spar again?

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Would you like something to eat before you go?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I would. I was just wishing for some tea...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Could I ask for hot water? I have some wonderfully fragrant tea leaves.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: Oh, of course.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, Hilda, why not rest a little before leaving?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Perfect. I was getting hungry.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Why ask my opinion? You've already decided... Fine. I'll eat. What's on the menu? Is it good?

steps.name: A Message within the Fragment
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Hilda] in 「Lindos Holy Land」, then go to [Hilda]'s hiding place.
2. When the conversation ends, turn in the quest to [Medea] in 「Lindos Holy Land」.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Tyrenia, you didn't need to come this far.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you for seeing us off.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: It's been so long since I spent time like this. I really enjoyed it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was good to meet you, Tyrenia.

lines.speaker: 티레니아
lines.text: I hope your next visit is for something good.
(Tyrenia smiles slightly.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Understood.
(Tyrenia bids farewell with the Chiron clan's distinctive greeting, then races back toward the Trial of Iron.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: As Tyrenia said, next time we should visit for a happy reason.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: We should.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: About the black moon fragments. Shouldn't we know why they were here?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Medea, you're going to tell us, right?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, may I speak first?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: But let's go to the place where I hid. If we're discussing something important, we may as well be careful.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Returning here, I understand why you insisted on this place.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Adjust the flow of magic a little, and no sound can escape.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The perfect hiding place...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: And you interrupted it. Sigh. Let's leave that subject.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Medea...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes...
(Medea takes out the black moon fragment and holds it toward the sky.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: When I received this, a scene appeared in my mind. Somewhere, Daphne was holding it and speaking to me.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Shall I help for a moment?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Pardon...? Oh...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s, your hand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Give me your hand for a moment. Your hand. Yes, that's it.
(The moment the adventurer takes Hilda's hand, a familiar figure faintly appears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne?

lines.speaker: 다프네의 환영
lines.text: 「Medea.」

lines.speaker: 다프네의 환영
lines.text: 「If you have obtained this, you must be with the goddess's follower. I should not have made you go through this. I am sorry.」

lines.speaker: 다프네의 환영
lines.text: 「My child, I wanted you to be happy. That is why I hoped you would never step into this night.」

lines.speaker: 다프네의 환영
lines.text: 「I obtained a promise from a ruler of the Demon Realm not to touch you, but that was a mistake. I should never have trusted a demon...」

lines.speaker: 다프네의 환영
lines.text: 「Keep this, which the greedy Lux desired. Return to Kali Village and store it somewhere quiet.」

lines.speaker: 다프네의 환영
lines.text: 「You will keep it safe. And there is no need to worry.」

lines.speaker: 다프네의 환영
lines.text: 「It was difficult, but I made it so that anyone who would not show you goodwill can neither remember nor enter Kali Village.」

lines.speaker: 다프네의 환영
lines.text: 「...Leave the rest to me... This is my final...」

lines.speaker: 다프네의 환영
lines.text: 「Promise...」
(Daphne's apparition scatters and disappears.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That is exactly what I saw.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's what Lux wanted, could it be...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The power of people like Hilda and me resides in these black moon fragments...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: ...Daphne... What on earth was she thinking...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did you see, Hilda?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: ...%s. Here, your hand.
(As Hilda takes the adventurer's hand again, an unfamiliar scene different from before faintly appears.)
(A giant runs toward someone approaching Lindos. The apparent enemy offers a hand, but the giant refuses.)
(The enemy easily deflects the giant's attack, sneers, and destroys all his weapons.)
(Only one remains. The giant draws a weapon combining an enormous sword with a cannon and charges the enemy.)
Thud.
(The giant's attack drives the enemy back, and something the enemy was wearing falls to the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glasses...?
(The giant seizes the fallen enemy and tries to pierce the heart, but suddenly coughs blood and collapses. His body turns into a broken statue and crumbles.)
(The giant's weapon disappears in the enemy's hand. With that final image, the vision of Lindos's past evaporates.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Sigh... Daphne... Have you truly gone mad...?
(Watching the scene, Hilda sinks to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Why show me this...? Briareus made his own choice to protect this place... This isn't what I wanted...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't tell me...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: To choose to become a slayer of gods, a Deicide...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: What I needed was somewhere to hide from Ouroboros... Daphne knows that...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: If an Agasura catches me, Ouroboros will come for me. And when Ouroboros comes, everything disappears...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Everyone will die... Only then does it end...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, pull yourself together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, there is a way.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: What is it...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Go to Kali with Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What she's doing seems insane, but perhaps it's her own way of caring.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I agree it is insane, though I do not know whether to call it consideration.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Thank you for the offer, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stay there for a while. You'll be all right with Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, if you want what you entrusted to me, come with me.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Sigh. That's unfair...
(Hilda rubs her forehead and sighs, then takes Medea's offered hand and stands.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I give in. I'll go. Happy?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad, Medea. Are you going straight to Kali?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There is no direct route from Lindos to Kali, so we must go to the Oscar Road. Let us travel together that far.

steps.name: Hello, and Hello Again
steps.objective: 1. Talk to [Hilda] in 「Lindos Holy Land」, then go to [Mandarava] on 「Oscar Road」. When the conversation ends, turn in the quest to [Mandarava] on 「Oscar Road」.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This path is remarkable, however often I see it. We merely threw a spirit, and it connected to the Oscar Road.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You threw Mandarava, and a path appeared?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We did as Glinda instructed, and it really happened.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Glinda must have put something inside Mandarava. Anyway, Medea...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Before we go to Kali, could we stop briefly at Dorothy Village? I'd like to say goodbye to Glinda and Binah...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Of course. With me here, you need not worry about %s either.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go, Hilda. You too, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Spirit, there you are.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mandarava? Why isn't he answering?
(The adventurer looks at Mandarava lying on the rock, then shakes him.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Aaaah, I'm dizzy! The sunlight was just so wonderful I lost myself in it!
(Awake again, Mandarava wriggles in %s's hands.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Medea? Hilda? You left separately. Why are you here together?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: No, no! That's not important. Hilda, listen.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Why? What's happened?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Leave here at once. Hurry.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Spirit, what do you mean?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: The ones Hilda least wants to meet seem to be in Glaston.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Mandarava, how do you know that?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I'm a spirit. I may know, or I may not. Stop talking and leave quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why have they come to Glaston...?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, it seems you must return to the village alone.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda, as the spirit says, there is no time to linger.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It'll be all right.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: It's all right. All right.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Hearing Mandarava say that makes me more anxious...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: This way is safe. It's a tunnel to Lifthrasir.
(Mandarava touches a nearby rock, and a large tunnel appears with a pop.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Since when has this been here?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Aren't you going?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Medea, let's go.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, do not worry about Hilda or me. Return to the village. I will contact you when the time comes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Medea. Goodbye, Hilda.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Take care, %s.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Bye-bye.
(Hilda and Medea say goodbye to Mandarava and the adventurer, then leave the road at a brisk pace.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: %s, let's go to the village now.
(Mandarava floats up and sits on %s's shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I've had my fill of sunlight. Even the leaves on my head are fresh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it time to go inside?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I need to go in and rest. Oh, there's a secret. I'll tell only you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A secret?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Daphne appeared before me. She brought incredibly fine stuffing and asked a favor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What favor?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: She asked me to make sure Hilda and Medea could leave safely. She said it was for Glinda too. You know what that means, don't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, a little...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I asked the goddess just in case, and she said it was all right. I heard that helping Hilda helps you too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Now, onward to the village!

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Huh...?
(Mandarava raises his head and looks at the sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: The movements of the spirits in Glaston have changed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it serious?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: No. It's good. The ominous energy disturbing people's minds vanished all at once. Oh, how curious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I'm not a spirit from that area, so I don't know. Let's go to the village!

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Oh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Have you seen the mandrake that was drying beside me? The one drying out with such a happy expression.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goodbye, Mandarava. I'll go ahead. I'll tell Glinda I didn't see you.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: My friend. Please. Help me. Please help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh... All right. Then you help me next time too, understood?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Yes. I promise!
(With no choice, the adventurer agrees to search for the herb with Mandarava and runs around the road.)
(Unaware that someone is watching from atop a distant fountain.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Hahaha. What an amusing spirit. And %s too. Everyone is so entertaining.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Sigh. Now Lux must be searching for the wing that can destroy it...

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Are you still there?
(Menoiti looks into the fountain, startling the mandrake soaking inside.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Go back now.
(Terrified, the mandrake climbs out of the fountain and runs toward Mandarava.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Hehe. Things are somewhat settled now.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Shall I keep watching a little longer?
